title: I O Engineering Consultant
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with EEPS Integration delivery staff and EEPS staff \- from technical to executive level \- to execute deployment timelines supporting implementation lifecycle across global teams
* Provide execution leadership tied to infrastructure for internal systems and delivering solutions to customers
* Plan and partner with Integration Lead (IL) on project deployment timelines and working closely with global project teams
* Provide concise written communication of deployment status and issues, with regular updates to resolution for visibility and transparency
* Establish and maintain strong relationship with internal \& external customers and 3rd party vendors across global teams
* Understand project value and impact, aligning to the program and project goals
* Drive best\-practices and documentation in support of repeatable processes
* Engage with Integration Leads to allow independent support of US\-evening cutover/implementation work, such as but not limited to:
* Untrusted and Trusted data center cutovers
* Trusted user site cutovers
* Voice migrations
* Possible cutovers for Firewall work or other internal projects
* Guest Access cutovers
* B2B tunnel migrations
* Regional Hub Migrations
* During non\-implementation time, focus on items such as, but not limited to:
* Build a Communications Repository
* To be leveraged for status updates and issue resolution
* Build a Key Contacts Repository
* For global teams and Business Partner\-specific integrations
* Implementation Plan Revisions
* Update cutsheets or implementation plans based on real\-time experiences
* Reviewing Rally Kanban Boards
* Resource for understanding where work is actively updated for global project teams
* Documentation Updates
* Support global project team with any administrative updates on current progress (IRAADs Project Plans, Rally Cards, as applicable)
* Overall Initiative: Suggest ideas and ways to offload the work being done by the US\-based Integration Leads during their non\-Business hours
  

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/related field or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years of professional IT experience, with steadily increasing responsibilities in the IT Infrastructure project management blended with Integration way of thought leadership
* 7\+ years of experience in managing IT Projects, initiatives and deliverables
* 5\+ years of Project Management experience, including:
	+ Analysis of requirements and documentation
	+ Project Issue and Risk mitigation/resolution
	+ Implementation/Deployment plan creation and management
	+ Project Communication and follow\-up
* Health Care industry or Fortune 100 size company and complexity experience
* Experience with Integration processes \& practices, methodologies and terminology
* Experience with hardware and software provisioning, procurement, contract interpretation and or compliance policies and processes
* Experience with generative AI APIs and frameworks like OpenAI, Google Gemini, Hugging Face, LangChain, AutoGen, or Microsoft Copilot Studio etc.
* IT experience (Infrastructure, Networking and Datacenter Migration)
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical project deployments of varying complexity across global team
* Solid experience utilizing SDLC and Integration methodologies to complete project implementation/deployments
* Understanding of Network and Systems technologies, including Microsoft email solutions
* Proven excellent collaboration, negotiation and influencing skills
* Proven to possess ability to craft effective prompts for generative AI systems (prompt engineering).
* Proven excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proven solid ability to proactively communicate concise, written summaries of issues and resolutions
* Proven excellent organizational skills and ability to initiate and own all aspects of multiple projects
* Proven solid inter\-personal skills to communicate effectively across all levels and audiences (executives, technologists, engineers, customers, vendors and other business professionals)
* Actively demonstrate critical thinking within daily activities and across all work deliverables
* Proven solid quantitative and qualitative analytical skills with a "can\-do' approach to solving problems
* Demonstrates self\-confidence and self\-reliance in all aspects of this role, including escalations
* Demonstrates ability to define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines
* Proven effectively manage and communicate implementation/deployment expectations to global team members and stakeholders in a timely manner
* Proven ability to consistently time manage effectively across multiple projects in a fast\-paced and changing environment
* Proven flexibility to adjust when needed, to think in the moment and propose solutions to challenges

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Lead
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Power BI and Microsoft Fabric Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for Power BI development, administration, platform support, performance optimization, governance, and Microsoft Fabric enablement. The role supports enterprise reporting and data\-platform operations, troubleshoots complex technical issues, establishes platform standards, and collaborates with technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and supportable Power BI and Fabric solutions**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop, enhance, troubleshoot, and optimize Power BI reports, semantic models, Dataflows, and Paginated Reports.
* Design and support solutions using DAX, Power Query/M, data modeling, Import, DirectQuery, and Composite Models.
* Analyze and resolve performance issues involving reports, visuals, DAX, semantic models, refreshes, data sources, and capacity utilization.
* Use Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, and Tabular Editor to assess and improve solution performance.
* Administer and support the enterprise Power BI Service, including workspaces, apps, semantic models, dataflows, gateways, refreshes, security, and access.
* Monitor Power BI Premium and Microsoft Fabric capacity utilization, workload performance, and operational health.
* Troubleshoot gateway, connectivity, refresh, capacity, deployment, and service\-related issues.
* Support Power BI REST APIs, deployment processes, automation, and operational improvements.
* Provide technical guidance, design recommendations, and code or model reviews to Power BI developers.
* Support Power BI governance, access controls, compliance, audit, risk\-management, and technical\-review activities.

* Support Microsoft Fabric architecture and workloads, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory/Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks, Semantic Models, Fabric Capacity, and Monitoring Hub.

* Establish sustainable support and operating processes for Microsoft Fabric as organizational adoption increases.
* Provide L2/L3 production support and own incidents from investigation through resolution, including root\-cause analysis for recurring issues.
* Coordinate with database, cloud, network, security, infrastructure, Microsoft, and vendor\-support teams to resolve platform issues.
* Communicate incidents, risks, dependencies, and technical recommendations clearly to technical teams, business users, and other stakeholders.
* Promote Power BI and Microsoft Fabric best practices, supportability, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

 **Required Technical Skills**

* Power BI Service and Power BI Desktop
* Microsoft Fabric architecture and platform concepts
* OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and Semantic Models
* Data Factory/Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Notebooks
* Power BI administration and enterprise platform support
* Power BI Premium and Microsoft Fabric Capacity
* DAX, Power Query/M, and data modeling
* Import, DirectQuery, and Composite Models
* Power BI gateways, Dataflows, and Paginated Reports
* Workspaces, apps, semantic models, security, and access management
* Power BI REST APIs and deployment processes
* Microsoft Fabric monitoring, governance, security, and capacity management
* Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, and Tabular Editor

 **Preferred Skills**

* PowerShell or Python and SQL Queries
* Microsoft Azure or Azure Data Factory
* Git and CI/CD
* Deployment Pipelines

 **Experience and Qualifications**

* Seven or more years of experience in Power BI, data analytics, or data\-platform engineering.
* Proven experience in Power BI administration, development, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Strong experience in report and semantic\-model performance optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with Paginated Reports, Dataflows, and enterprise gateways.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric architecture and platform workloads.
* Experience with enterprise governance, access management, risk, compliance, or similar platform controls.
* Experience working within a structured production\-support or IT service\-management environment is preferred.

 **Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting skills.
* Hands\-on technical approach across both development and platform administration.
* Strong ownership and incident\-management capabilities.
* Effective communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business communication.
* Strong documentation, collaboration, and knowledge\-sharing skills.
* Commitment to continuously learning and adopting new Microsoft Fabric capabilities.

By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. With over three decades of experience, we are committed to providing innovative and reliable solutions for the solar energy sector.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - PostgreSQL, pgvector
description:
Position Overview
  
  

We are looking for a Database Platform Reliability Engineer (DBRE) with deep operational expertise in AWS\-managed data services to own the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of our growing polyglot data estate.
  
In this role, you will manage a diverse database environment—spanning PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora), search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), and graph systems (Neo4j)—while partnering directly with application and AI/ML teams on database design and platform selection. If you are passionate about database reliability engineering, automation, and expanding into AI\-adjacent patterns like vector search (pgvector) and RAG architecture, this role offers room to scale both technically and strategically. Responsibilities
  
  

**Fleet Reliability \& HA/DR:** Manage high availability, Point\-in\-Time Recovery (PITR), disaster recovery, and zero\-downtime upgrades across RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Neo4j.
  
**Performance \& Capacity:** Lead query tuning, index optimization, sharding strategies, parameter configuration, and proactive capacity planning.
  
**Automation \& IaC:** Provision and manage data platforms using Terraform , Ansible , and Docker/Kubernetes integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  
**Observability \& Incident Response:** Build monitoring, logging, and alerting via Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch ; participate in an on\-call rotation for advanced troubleshooting.
  
**Data Architecture \& AI Enablement:** Advise development teams on schema design and database selection; implement and optimize vector search capabilities ( pgvector , OpenSearch vector engine) for AI/ML workloads.
  
**Security \& Compliance:** Enforce network isolation (VPC), encryption at rest/transit (KMS), and fine\-grained access management (IAM). Key Qualifications
  
  

**Database Experience:** 4 to 7 years administering production PostgreSQL on AWS (RDS/Aurora), alongside hands\-on operational experience with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch or Neo4j .
  
**DBRE Fundamentals:** Deep knowledge of backup strategies, failover mechanics, performance tuning, and cross\-platform data modelling.
  
**DevOps Tooling:** Proficient with Terraform, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD tools, and scripting ( Python / Bash ).
  
**Bonus Skills:** Hands\-on experience with vector search, Redis/ElastiCache, DynamoDB, or LLM/RAG application architectures.
  
**Certifications (Preferred):** AWS Certified Database – Specialty, CKA, or platform\-specific certifications (PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Neo4j).

2\. Implement and maintain ITIL\-aligned processes for incident, problem, and change management within LAN/WAN environments, ensuring compliance with security and data privacy standards.
  

3\. Conduct root cause analysis for escalated network incidents and execute remediation strategies to prevent recurrence and strengthen network resilience.
  

4\. Proactively monitor network infrastructure using platforms such as SolarWinds or Cisco Prime, identifying security vulnerabilities and coordinating prompt mitigation actions.
  

5\. Maintain and update comprehensive network documentation and knowledge bases, supporting efficient operations and knowledge transfer within the team.
  

6\. Mentor and deliver technical training to team members and new joiners on LAN/WAN management best practices, fostering skill development and productivity.
  

7\. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate, and secure resolution of network\-related issues, contributing to high customer satisfaction scores.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Advanced proficiency in LAN/WAN technologies, including configuration and troubleshooting of routers, switches, and firewalls (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent).
  

2\. Solid understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, VPN).
  

3\. Strong experience with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Cisco Prime).
  

4\. Indepth knowledge of ITIL processes and their application in network support operations.
  

5\. Good awareness of security best practices and data privacy standards in network environments.
  

6\. Ability to analyze and resolve technical issues independently and communicate solutions effectively within the team.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent certification is optional but valuable.
  

2\. ITIL Foundation certification is recommended.

title: Site Engineer (Civil)/Site supervisor
description:

**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Qualification:** Diploma / B.Tech in Civil or Electrical Engineering

We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager / Site Execution Manager** with hands\-on experience in **retail and dark\-store fit\-outs**. The candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end site execution, vendor management, quality control and timely project completion.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand and interpret **MEP, fixture drawings and layouts**.
* Understand BOQs covering **complete civil and electrical fit\-outs** for dark stores, warehouses and retail stores.
* Conduct **site recce/surveys** and prepare BOQs as per approved layouts.
* Execute and manage **15–20\+ dark stores/retail stores** for corporate brands such as **Zepto, Blinkit, Zudio, Burger King**, etc.
* Coordinate and manage **vendor teams at site** to ensure timely project completion.
* Arrange vendors and manpower at short notice in case of urgent project requirements.
* Prepare **day\-wise execution plans** and ensure projects are completed within deadlines.
* Negotiate vendor costs and ensure execution **within the approved project budget**.
* Maintain close coordination with **client service teams, vendors and client Project Managers**.
* Obtain final **MB Sheet / WCC** sign\-off from the Client PM after project completion and submit the same for billing.
* Share **daily work progress reports** with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure **quality, snag\-free execution and adherence to project specifications**.
* Verify the **make/brand of materials** and ensure all items supplied are as per the BOQ.
* Handle site\-level escalations and resolve issues effectively.
* Ensure compliance with **safety standards and project\-specific requirements**.
* Maintain adequate **site stock/material availability** for smooth execution.
* Ensure complete **store readiness before opening**.
* Manage multiple projects and work effectively under pressure to meet strict deadlines.
* Willingness to undertake **Pan\-India travel** as required.

Desired Skills

* Strong **vendor management and negotiation skills**.
* Good understanding of **retail fit\-outs, civil and electrical works**.
* Strong project execution and site management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and work under tight timelines.
* Strong problem\-solving and escalation\-handling skills.
* **Established vendor network** across locations will be an added advantage.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
